transcript.text: Now let's compute per-region net revenue over completed orders.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_revenue
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

West has the highest net revenue (amount - discount) among completed orders, confirming it as the primary region under the corrected definition.
